EPI_NA_CHECK_HTTP_REQUEST
Description
This event triggered when special http request comes. Internal event for
Endpoint Inspector/Network Access iRule invocation, triggered when
special status check request arrives, which are:
‘/my.status.eps’
‘/my.status.na’
‘/my.report.na’.
This event is required for internal needs to provide extra
functionality for Network Access and Endpoint Inspector client
applications. Requires the APM module.
Examples
when
EPI_NA_CHECK_HTTP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.notice
"Client requested or reported status update"
}
